findings.text: the red arm named in the manifest was run against a superseded revision of this test, not the committed one: logs/parent-arm.log:63 fails at line 169 while the committed assertion sits at line 173, so the parent-arm log is not a receipt for the landed test.

the base arm executed the newly added test (its fork DeprecationWarning is emitted from tests/test_a_live_worker_never_reads_gone_after_its_first_commit.py:48), so the arm labelled revision e7eca9f03 ran the head worktree and its identical 12 failed / 1264 passed against the head arm is not a base-versus-head comparison.

the base arm's final line reads EXIT=0 while its own summary two lines above reports 12 failed, so a reader that takes the last line as the arm's status reads a passing arm; the true pytest exit EXIT=1 sits on line 677.

the base arm's recorded command carries the placeholder <110 recovery importers> instead of the literal command, so the log cannot be reproduced and its labelled revision cannot be checked against what it ran.
